intro: Moldova is a parliamentary republic, officially neutral, and a candidate to join the EU.

chapters.title: Parliament and president
text: The 101-member parliament chooses the government, and the president is directly elected. Its constitution declares Moldova permanently neutral. The country uses the Moldovan leu.

chapters.title: Gagauzia and Transnistria
text: Gagauzia has autonomy within Moldova. Transnistria is outside the government's control.
